The PASI Collector is responsible for performing outbound and inbound collection activities to resolve patient account balances. • Reviews and analyzes patient accounts to respond to inquiries, explain balances, and identify appropriate resolution options.

• Uses billing and account management systems to research account activity, update notes, and document collection actions.

• Communicates clearly and professionally with patients, teammates, and management to support effective account resolution.

• Maintains accurate and timely documentation of all account activity in accordance with departmental standards and compliance requirements.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

• Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

• H.S. Diploma or GED required

• Ability to communicate professionally and courteously with patients regarding sensitive financial information.

• Ability to analyze account data and apply basic problem-solving skills to resolve billing questions.

• Proficiency in using billing, account management, and call management systems.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document account activity.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, call-driven environment.

• Proficiency in conducting research to understand unfamiliar terminology, concepts, or industry-specific terms.

11. Ethical Standards:

• Integrity and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

12. Flexibility:

• Adaptability to different types of content, tones, and styles.

• Providing a portfolio or samples of your work can demonstrate your translation abilities and give employers an insight into your skills.

1. Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and skills in the translation field.

It requires someone who can walk into a complex merchant environment, understand how systems connect, identify friction, and turn that into a requirements picture engineering and design can build against.

We value specificity over generalism, forward-thinking over comfort with the status quo, and partners over vendors.

title: Független Értékesítő - Dombóvár
description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

- Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

- Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

title: Solution Architect - Regulatory (RIM)
description:
Position Description

The Solution Architect is a senior, customer-facing leader with a deep background in Pharmaceutical Regulatory who owns the full post-sale journey for Kivo’s customers. The primary focus of this role is driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion through proactive success management that starts with leading hands-on implementation projects and continues through to Customer Success interactions. You will build deep, trusted relationships with Kivo’s customers, lead implementations that set customers up for long-term success and serve as their strategic partner throughout their time with Kivo. This role thrives at the intersection of strategic account management and operational delivery in regulated environments. While primarily US-focused, the role may require occasional time-shifting to support EU-based implementation projects and customers.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation Consulting

Working in partnership with Kivo’s US based implementation team:

•
Solution Design: Engage early in the sales process to assist with the definition of requirements and project scoping

•
Deliver implementations: Lead end-to-end implementations of the Kivo platform through structured project management, and governance.

•
Design & configure: Facilitate discovery and design workshops; translate regulated process requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) into configured platform solutions with documented decisions and guide the adoption of Kivo.

•
Support validation: Support the customer’s validation workstream by educating customers in the Kivo validation methodology and providing an orientation to Kivo documentation.

•
Support data migration: Partner with the Data Migration team on discovery, field mapping, dry-run coordination, and production cutover checklists for compliant data transfers.

•
Enable go-live: Guide customers through change management activities: defect triage, go-live readiness assessments, user training enablement, and post-go-live stabilization.

Customer Success

Working in partnership with the VP, Services:

•
Own account health: Manage a portfolio of NA accounts as the primary strategic point of contact post-implementation

•
Drive outcomes and expansion: Build and maintain tailored success plans aligned to each customer’s business goals; partner with Sales to identify, qualify, and advance expansion and upsell opportunities within your portfolio.

•
Executive alignment: Cultivate senior-level relationships within customer organizations; deliver executive-ready insights, business reviews, and ROI narratives that reinforce Kivo’s value.

•
Champion the customer: Serve as the primary voice of Kivo customers to the internal team-surface product feedback, advocate for roadmap priorities, and collaborate with Product on features and packaged offerings that reflect NA market needs.

•
Manage upgrades and adoption: Proactively manage customers through new feature releases and configuration changes, ensuring smooth adoption and building internal champions who drive platform utilization.

•
Retain and grow the base: Own GRR and NRR metrics for your portfolio; develop and execute playbooks for at-risk accounts, renewals, and expansion conversations in coordination with Sales leadership.

What You’ve Done

Required

• 5-10+ years of experience in a customer success, implementation, or blended services role (e.g. Delivery Lead) within a life-sciences SaaS environment (pharma, biotech, med-device, or CRO).

• Strong domain knowledge in Regulatory Affairs or Operations for pharmaceutical/biotech or medtech industries is a must

• Demonstrated track record managing across a portfolio of accounts.

• Working knowledge of regulated industry requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) and comfort supporting validation deliverables (CSA/CSV).

• Experience leading software implementations in a regulated environment, including project planning, stakeholder management, and go-live delivery.

title: Senior AWS Cloud Consultant - NM
description:
DVT is one of the top software development companies on the continent. Our software engineers are consulting on cutting-edge applications at top companies in South Africa, as well as consulting globally. You will have the opportunity to work alongside some of the most established developers in the country and globally with the latest technologies.
DVT is committed to continuously training our staff and we are very proud of our culture of learning, internal speaking and training at a variety of sponsored technical events across the AWS ecosystem.
We are looking for a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer to join a strategic cloud transformation programme. This is a hands-on consulting role requiring deep AWS engineering expertise, strong technical leadership, and the ability to design and deliver production-grade cloud platforms.
This role is not suited to candidates whose experience has primarily involved deploying applications into AWS environments designed by others. We are specifically looking for an engineer who has personally designed, built, configured and operated AWS infrastructure in production and can confidently own architecture, security, networking and operational decisions.
You'll play a key role in shaping AWS architecture, driving CI/CD transformation, enabling Salesforce integrations, improving observability, and providing technical leadership across multiple workstreams.
Requirements
AWS Cloud Engineering & Architecture

• Own AWS solution architecture, platform design and environment configuration.

• Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure supporting production workloads.

• Make key decisions around AWS service selection, security, networking, scalability, resilience and operational management.

• Drive infrastructure automation and standardisation using Infrastructure as Code.

• Ensure cloud solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned to AWS best practices.

• Lead technical design discussions and provide architectural guidance across delivery teams.

Salesforce ↔ AWS Integration

• Design and build integrations between Salesforce and AWS-hosted systems.

• Implement synchronous API integrations, EventBridge event-driven integrations and S3-based batch processing solutions.

• Design secure, reliable and supportable integration patterns.

title: Senior Brand Manager - Beauty - AMAZON
description:
Senior Brand Manager - Beauty
ABOUT NEATO
Neato is a 2P eCommerce accelerator based in Las Vegas. We buy inventory from established brands and operate as their exclusive online retailer across every major channel - Amazon, TikTok Shop, DTC, and Walmart - all fulfilled from a single inventory pool. Unlike agencies that get paid whether you grow or not, we make money when we sell your product. When we don't, we eat it. Every decision we make is backed by our own capital.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Senior Brand Manager owns the profit and loss of a beauty portfolio inside that model. You are the one person accountable for contribution margin - the number that says whether the brand is worth Neato 's capital every week. You set the price, protect the buy box, keep the shelves in stock, run the promotional calendar, chase the reimbursements, and answer for the result.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
✓ Availability - in-stock rate on every ASIN, every day. You set the reorder cadence with Supply Chain and own stockouts before they happen.
✓ Price & margin - every price on every channel. Buy box protection. MAP enforcement. Margin defense when algorithms move against you.
✓ Merchandising, assortment, conversion - detail pages, A+ content, video, imagery, reviews, variations. Anything a shopper sees is your surface.
✓ Profit recovery - billbacks, reimbursements, chargebacks, shortage claims. Money left on the table is money you're accountable for.
✓ Marketplace control - unauthorized sellers, MAP violators, counterfeits. You quarterback the enforcement plan with Legal and the brand.
✓ Demand generation - ad strategy, Vine, PPC, DSP, external traffic. You set the plan; the Ads team executes; you own the ROAS.
✓ Promotion & subscription - promo calendar, deal cadence, Subscribe & Save base growth. Every promo has a P&L before it runs.
✓ Brand partnership - you are the face Neato shows the brand. Weekly reviews, quarterly strategy, joint planning. When the brand escalates, they call you first.
HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
✓ Portfolio contribution margin - trend and absolute.
✓ In-stock rate - across the assortment.
✓ Buy box ownership rate - on 1P and 3P.
✓ Subscribe & Save base growth - month over month.
✓ Reimbursement dollars recovered - against opportunity.
✓ Brand partner NPS - they renew or they don't.
WHAT YOU BRING
✓ 7-10+ years operating a beauty CPG brand's P&L - direct Amazon 1P and 3P operating experience, not agency-adjacent.
✓ Weekly numbers cadence - you read the P&L to peers every week without notes.
✓ Reimbursement fluency - you know what Amazon owes you and how to collect it.
✓ MAP enforcement experience - across marketplaces.
✓ Contribution-margin literacy - you can defend a promo or a price change to a CFO.
✓ Bias to action - over meetings and decks.
NICE TO HAVE
★ TikTok Shop, DTC, Walmart - hands-on experience, or fast to learn.
WHY YOU'LL WANT THIS
This is a true P&L seat, not a coordination role - you set price, own the promo calendar, and answer directly for contribution margin, with performance-linked upside tied to the result. You partner daily with Supply Chain, Creative, Ads, and Finance, and you're the person the brand calls first when it matters.

title: Vice President of Sales

Who we are
Adlib is the AI Production Layer for regulated industries. We turn complex, unstructured documents into governed, validated, AI-ready data so enterprises can make defensible decisions without rebuilding their stack. Customers see 60% fewer exceptions, 50% faster cycle times and 70% less manual handling.
On top of that trusted data layer sits our agentic intake capability. Agents read the packet, decide what it is, apply the customer’s rules, route the exception and trigger the next action. The document layer establishes trust in the data. The agentic layer acts on it.
For insurance carriers that means agentic intake across FNOL packets, police reports, medical records, adjuster notes, loss runs, submissions and endorsements. We are model-agnostic and system-agnostic by design, sitting in front of Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco rather than replacing any of it. We serve life sciences, insurance and public sector customers, and we are backed by Diversis Capital.

Insurance is our core growth driver and this role goes deepest there, but it carries the whole company number across life sciences, public sector and OEM as well, worldwide. It also has to absorb sellers and systems from an acquisition, and leave the sales function in a state that stands up to institutional scrutiny.

We are blending a startup mentality with an established business, so you can innovate faster while deploying proven sales tactics and processes that work. You are building the machine: territory and quota design, capacity planning, methodology, deal inspection, and a forecast the Board can rely on. description:
Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
As Staff Product Designer , you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi 's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.

•
Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.

•
Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.

•
Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.

Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

title: Principal, Product Analytics
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal, Product Analytics who loves getting to the bottom of things. You'll do the deep investigative and technical work that explains why users and customers behave the way they do, and turn it into decisions that change the product and the business.

We're building a more proactive data function, and this role is its deep-investigation engine. You'll take ambiguous, high-stakes questions about user behaviour and customer experience and follow them wherever the data leads, across acquisition, activation, usage and the wider customer journey.

You'll work hands-on and independently, partnering with Product Managers, engineering managers and commercial teams, and working alongside a VP of Growth who will set the function's direction and build the team. Your findings will inform experiments, the roadmap and company strategy.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go looking for what nobody asked about. This is the heart of the role. You'll notice when something looks off in a funnel, a cohort or a metric, disappear into it, and come back with a product issue, a cost leak or an opportunity nobody was looking for. You set much of your own agenda, and you don't wait for a request to start digging.

- Lead deep investigations into user behaviour and customer experience across product and non-product touchpoints, including support, customer success and sales.

- Find where activation breaks. Identify failure points in the user journey, including those that could become productised capabilities.

- Understand acquisition and intent. Dig into acquisition channels, user use cases and what people are actually trying to achieve.

- Do rigorous causal and statistical work. Go beyond correlation with regression, causal analysis and well-designed experiments, and be clear about what the evidence does and doesn't support.

- Build models that drive action. Apply data science to real business problems, such as churn modelling that can trigger real-time product action, and explain clearly how models are applied and what impact they have.

- Analyse unstructured and AI-specific data. Work with agent-user conversations, context layers and evaluation systems alongside structured product data.

- Size opportunities. Produce market opportunity sizing that helps the business prioritise.

- Measure how we build. Partner with engineering managers on organisational productivity metrics.

- Communicate for impact. Translate findings into clear recommendations for product teams, management and executives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

MUST-HAVES

- Deep product analytics experience across growth and broader product areas, with a record of investigations that changed decisions.

- Data science and modelling experience, and the ability to explain how you applied it and what business impact it had.

- Strong grounding in correlation, regression and causal analysis.

- A proactive approach. You surface insights and shape the agenda rather than working to a brief.

- Genuine curiosity. You notice what looks off and dig until you understand why.

- Clear communication with management and executives about business impact, simplifying complex analysis into actionable recommendations.

title: Head of FP&A | Credit Products
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE TEAM

Nu's Finance organization is structured into functional areas that together safeguard financial stability, compliance and strategic decision-making. Most core finance functions operate under a dual reporting structure - reporting directly into the global Finance team, with a dotted line to the business they support - which keeps us close to the operation while holding a consistent global standard.

Within Finance, FP&A owns budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning, and acts as the analytical partner behind the company's biggest decisions. The team drives profitable growth by improving visibility, forecasting quality, consolidation and analysis of results and key metrics, translating them into insights and recommended actions for senior management. It also defines the performance metrics that create accountability and ownership across FP&A and the business units - tracking them consistently to measure progress, monitor KPIs and drive cost optimization.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Head of Credit Products FP&A to be the finance owner for Nu's consumer and small business credit businesses across all markets - Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, the United States, and the geographies we enter next. Credit is the engine that powers Nubank's economics, and this role is the person leadership turns to when the question is how that engine actually behaves: what drives revenue, what drives losses, and how the two reconcile into a single view of each product.

The scope covers every credit product we offer, including credit card, personal loans, and other lending products, and it will grow as Nu launches new products and enters new markets. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and consistent exposure to senior leadership, including the executives who run these businesses. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals.

We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to own Anduril’s composites supply base, expediting the qualification and implementation of composite structures and components, such as airframe skins, wings and control surfaces, fairings, radomes and motor cases, with our suppliers. You will optimize these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own and manage the composites commodity and its subcategories, including carbon and glass fiber reinforced structures, prepreg and wet layup parts, cored/sandwich panels and bonded assemblies, to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines

• Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage

• Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory layout, facilities and workforce for inclusion in the Approved Supplier List, including cure equipment (autoclaves, ovens, presses), layup room environmental controls, material storage and out-time tracking, and NDI capability

• Support Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE

• Own bringing up new production tooling & lines at Supplier sites, including layup tools and molds, trim and drill fixtures, bond jigs and automated layup cells, to ensure materials, processes & tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality (criteria set by SQE) and demand requirements

• Own capacity expansion readiness and production ramp-up at Supplier, including cure capacity, rate tooling and skilled layup labor

• Establish and drive process performance and controls (SPC) reviews at Supplier, covering cure cycle records, porosity and NDI results, witness coupon and mechanical test data, and dimensional results

• Partner with Anduril design engineering on design for manufacturability of composite parts, including ply layup and orientation, tooling approach, tolerancing and process selection

• Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time over the product lifecycle, such as moving from hand layup to automated or out-of-autoclave processes where it makes sense

• Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team and Suppliers on composite defects such as porosity, voids, delamination and bond-line failures, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions

description:

U.S. Citizenship and Residency Required

Job Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to replace repetitive manual tasks across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) with reliable, reusable automation. The role focuses on automating patch management across the environment using tools such as Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).

• Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles to automate patch management procedures

• Use Terraform to maintain repeatable infrastructure configurations that support patch management workflows.

• Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely deploy patch management automation to production.

• Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates required by automated patching workflows through HashiCorp Vault.

• Use JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure artifacts used by patch management pipelines.

• Validate automated patching workflows against existing manual procedures before replacing manual patching activities.

• Track and report on patch automation coverage and reductions in manual patching effort and related ticket volume across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

• BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, patch management, or related engineering roles, including patching automation.

• Hands-on experience using Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault to support production patch management workflows.

• Experience analyzing patching tickets and incident data in ServiceNow or a similar ITSM tool to identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve patch delivery.

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

Make world-class AI inference feel effortless for developers.

Building with AI models should be easy. Getting them into production, understanding their performance, and scaling them reliably is anything but. At Baseten, we're changing that.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the experience of building on Baseten, from discovering and evaluating models to deploying, optimizing, and operating them in production.

You'll help shape some of our most important products, including Model APIs, Dedicated Inference, Model Evaluations, and our Model Library. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer experience, and product strategy.

- Own product strategy and roadmap across Baseten's inference offerings, with a focus on developer adoption and business impact

- Work with inference engineers and researchers to turn technical advances into compelling customer-facing capabilities

- Help determine which models, workloads, and customer needs we prioritize

- Partner with GTM and leadership on pricing, packaging, launches, and commercialization

- Spend time with developers and customers to understand what's working, what's frustrating, and what we should build next

REQUIREMENTS

- 10+ years building and shipping AI/ML products or platforms

- Strong understanding of model serving, GPU economics, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, throughput, and cost

- Exceptional developer product instincts. You know how to make complex technology approachable without sacrificing power

- A track record of leading cross-functional product initiatives and turning technical capabilities into measurable adoption or revenue growth

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience deploying models, building infrastructure products, building ML infrastructure, or designing tools used from both a terminal and a console

- Past experience as a software developer

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

title: Utilization Management Nurse RN
description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Ready to make the right call on care, fast, fairly, and by the book?
Why This Role Matters
Every day, members and providers are waiting on a decision that shapes what care happens next. As a Utilization Management Nurse, you’re the clinical expert who gets it right. You’ll review requests against plan language, medical policies, and evidence-based criteria, then deliver timely, compliant determinations that protect both member access and appropriate use of resources. When a case needs a deeper look, you’ll route it to the Medical Director and support appeals with clear, complete clinical summaries. Your documentation keeps us audit-ready under NCQA and URAC standards. When you deliver accurate, on-time decisions, members get the care they need and the organization earns the trust that keeps our programs strong.
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time, with rotating Saturday coverage as required.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Decide with clinical rigor: Perform medical-necessity reviews and level-of-care determinations using benefit language, plan documents, medical policies, and nationally recognized evidence-based criteria such as MCG (and NCCN as applicable), in line with state and federal requirements.

•
Apply criteria consistently: Hold to policy every time, and when a request doesn’t meet criteria, route it promptly to the Medical Director for secondary clinical review and potential adverse determination per UM policy and accreditation standards.

•
Dig into the documentation: Analyze clinical records for completeness, spot risk and acuity indicators, flag inconsistencies or missing information, and start outreach or escalation right away per UM workflow.

•
Prioritize what can’t wait: Organize your workload around urgency, regulatory and accreditation time frames, and potential member impact, and raise barriers early so determinations stay timely and compliant.

•
Steer care in-network: Confirm eligibility, benefits, authorization requirements, and network status to support benefit-compliant redirection when it’s clinically appropriate.

•
Power the appeals process: Prepare clinical summaries and supporting documentation, coordinate peer-to-peer and Medical Director discussions when indicated, and route cases on time per policy, including Independent Review Organization (IRO) processes when required.

•
Document with precision: Record reviews, rationale, criteria and policy citations, communications, and outcomes accurately and in real time in designated UM systems to support quality oversight, reporting, and audit readiness.

•
Hit the standard: Meet productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround-time expectations, take part in calibration and quality activities, and put feedback to work in your daily practice.

•
Protect member privacy: Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality using minimum-necessary standards, and complete required training and annual competencies by their deadlines.

•
Back up the team: Cross-train and provide cross-coverage to keep operations running and service-level commitments met.

Qualifications
What You Bring to Our Team
Education & Experience:

• Current, unrestricted RN license in the United States or a U.S. territory (compact license acceptable where applicable)

• Graduate of an accredited nursing program (ADN or diploma required; BSN preferred)

• Minimum 1-2 years of recent clinical experience in acute care, med-surg, I
